before-hazeel-cult.npc: Hello there. I haven't seen you around here before. If you've come to admire the Carnillean family home, I must warn you not to cause any trouble.
Due to recent criminal activities against such prominent Ardougnians, I have been sent here on special guard duty to ensure the Carnilleans' security.
Anyone caught interfering with the person or possessions of any Carnilleans will be taken to jail so quickly that their feet won't even touch the floor!

before-hazeel-cult.player: Well, I wasn't actually planning on doing anything like that...

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-carnillean.npc: Well look who it is! Good to see you managed to clear your name. I always had faith in you!

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-carnillean.player: Thanks! So is everything all quiet around here now?

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-carnillean.npc: Indeed! For now at least, everything is back to normal.

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-hazeel.npc: Hello, adventurer. It's a shame you never found that cult. We have a horrible suspicion that there's been another burglary.
Yes, it is. The thing is, we can't even work out what they've taken! It's all very odd.

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-hazeel.player: Is there anything more I can do to help?

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-hazeel.npc: I don't think so. Sir Ceril says you've done enough.
